newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba to cut back chip investment.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba to cut back chip investment.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Wednesday that it would cut back its group capital investment in semiconductors by 10 billion yen to 170 billion yen for the year ending March 1997.
A company spokesman said the cutback reflected the drop in prices for 16-megabit DRAM memory chips.
Toshiba expects its chip production for the year to be 10 percent below its original forecast, he said. Its sales forecast for the year is now 950 billion yen.
Toshiba said it expects prices of 16-megabit DRAMs to recover by the end of December following production adjustments and new demand for chips for digital video discs (DVDs).

The spokesman said prices of 16-megabit DRAMs for volume users were now being quoted at around 1,200 yen, down from around 5,000 yen at the beginning of this year. Spot prices have been below 1,000 yen.
